browser: Chromium (headless, HTML injected into an in-memory page)
limitation: The managed browser blocked both file:// and loopback HTTP navigation. Tests used set_content on the supplied self-contained HTML. Direct file navigation, reload persistence and browser-specific local file storage were not verified.
checks: All 20 lesson articles load without external JavaScript or stylesheet requests.
Search hides nonmatching lessons and Clear restores all 20.
Score thresholds and study/lab flags record completion; note text is handled as text rather than executable markup.
Invalid progress import is rejected without changing prior state.
Valid progress import accepts confirmation and replaces values.
Desktop 1440px and mobile 390px layouts have no horizontal page overflow.
